[Power Imbalance Anthology] Don't Be Nice to the Man Next Door

description:
*“Si, Si-U…? What’s that…? Something strange keeps brushing against me…”*

Min Tae-Ha, who had unwittingly become friends with Lee Si-U, the man next door who wraps himself up tightly in a gloomy manner and jumps at the sight of anyone, and showed him some human kindness. Tae-Ha, who usually maintains a certain distance, finds himself unable to do so with Si-U, even though there’s an eight-year age gap between them. Perhaps it’s because he saw Si-U as a child who was only big in stature but otherwise incredibly fragile. His uninhibited affection for Si-U ended up coming back to haunt him.

On what should have been a happy day, the day his girlfriend proposed to him, Tae-Ha is grabbed by Si-U and “kidnapped” to his house…

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Bulgongjeong Danpyeonseon (불공정 단편선) Collection.*
